camel_example: aliyun ccc ListCallDetailRecords --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy ASC --ContactType 'Outbound,Inbound' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId '9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb30000' --ContactDisposition 'NoAnswer,AbandonedInContactFlow,AbandonedRing' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime 1532448000000 --PhoneNumber 12344560000 --Criteria '客服组' --ContactId 123 --WithRecording true --StopTime 1532707199000
description_en: Retrieves call detail record (CDR) data from a call center
description_zh: 获取呼叫中心中的通话详单数据
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-call-detail-records --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb30000 --phone-number 12344560000 --start-time 1532448000000 --stop-time 1532707199000 --criteria '客服组' --contact-type Outbound,Inbound --contact-disposition NoAnswer,AbandonedInContactFlow,AbandonedRing --with-recording true --contact-id 123 --order-by ASC --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCallDetailRecords

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the call center for which you want to retrieve data
parameters.help_zh: 待获取数据的呼叫中心的电话号码
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates the start of the current day (00:00)
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间。缺省为0，代表从当天的0时开始
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates the current time
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间。缺省为0，代表截止到目前的时间
parameters.name: stop_time

parameters.help_en:
The search criteria.

You can search by customer phone number, agent name, or skill group name
parameters.help_zh:
搜索条件。

可以根据客户电话、坐席姓名、技能组名称来搜索
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by call type.

Valid values: Inbound (inbound call), Outbound (outbound call), Back2Back (dual call), PredictiveDial (predictive dialing), PrivacyDial (virtual number outbound call). Separate multiple values with commas
parameters.help_zh:
按呼叫类型筛选。

取值：Inbound（呼入），Outbound（呼出），Back2Back（双呼），PredictiveDial（预测试外呼），PrivacyDial（虚拟号码外呼） 多个条件以逗号隔开
parameters.name: contact_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by hangup type.

Valid values: Success (normal), NoAnswer (not connected), AbandonedInContactFlow (abandoned in IVR), AbandonedInQueue (abandoned in queue), AbandonedRing (abandoned while ringing), QueueOverflow (queue timeout), OneStepTransfer (transferred to external line). Separate multiple values with commas
parameters.help_zh:
按挂断类型筛选。

取值：Success(正常)，NoAnswer(未接通)，AbandonedInContactFlow(IVR中放弃)，AbandonedInQueue(排队放弃)，AbandonedRing(振铃放弃)，QueueOverflow(排队超时)，OneStepTransfer(转外线)，多个条件以逗号隔开
parameters.name: contact_disposition

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include recordings. Default value: true. Explicitly setting this to false can speed up the query
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要录音。默认需要，显式的指明不需要可以加快查询速度
parameters.name: with_recording

parameters.help_en: The contact ID used to query the record of a specific call. You can obtain the contact ID through the softphone SDK during a call
parameters.help_zh: 通过指定的contactId来查询某一通电话的记录，contactId可以通过软电话SDK发生通话时获取到
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The sort order by time. Default value: ASC. Valid values: ASC and DESC
parameters.help_zh: 按时间升降序排列。默认升序，取值: ASC/DESC
parameters.name: order_by

CallDetailRecord.description_en: The list of call detail records

AgentNames.description_en: The agents involved in the call. Multiple agents are separated by commas
AgentNames.description_zh: 参与通话的座席，多个座席之间以逗号分隔

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID, which is the same as the RAM user ID of the agent
AgentId.description_zh: 座席ID，等同于该座席的RAM子账户ID

Feedback.description_en: The secondary feedback information in case of dissatisfaction
Feedback.description_zh: 不满意情况下二级反馈信息

ContactDisposition.description_en:
The reason why the call ended.

Valid values: Success (normal), NoAnswer (not connected), AbandonedInContactFlow (abandoned in IVR), AbandonedInQueue (abandoned in queue), AbandonedRing (abandoned while ringing), QueueOverflow (queue timeout), OneStepTransfer (transferred to external line)
ContactDisposition.description_zh:
电话结束原因。

参考枚举值：Success(正常)，NoAnswer(未接通)，AbandonedInContactFlow(IVR中放弃)，AbandonedInQueue(排队放弃)，AbandonedRing(振铃放弃)，QueueOverflow(排队超时)，OneStepTransfer(转外线)

ContactId.description_en: The contact ID, which is globally unique and corresponds to the ACID in ACC
ContactId.description_zh: 话务ID，全局唯一，对应于 ACC的ACID

ContactType.description_en:
The call type.

Valid values: Inbound(0) (inbound call), Outbound(1) (outbound call), Internal(2) (internal call)
ContactType.description_zh:
通话类型。

参考枚举值：Inbound(0) 内呼, Outbound(1) 外呼, Internal(2) 内部通话

Duration.description_zh: 通话持续时间，单位为秒

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the call center

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID, which is the same as the RAM user ID of the agent
AgentId.description_zh: 座席ID，等同于该座席的RAM子账户ID

FileDescription.description_en: The alias of the recording file

QualityCheckTaskId.description_en: The ID of the intelligent quality check task

QualityCheckTid.description_en: The text ID of the intelligent quality check

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the call

Satisfaction.description_en:
The key pressed for the satisfaction rating, such as 1 or 2.

Note: This field is returned only when a satisfaction survey invitation is sent to the customer and the customer provides feedback. If the invitation is not sent or the customer does not respond, this field is not included in the response
Satisfaction.description_zh:
满意度对应的按键，比如1或者2。

注：只有在发送满意度邀请给客户，并且客户做出评价反馈后，才返回本字段。如果未发送或者发送但未评价，返回内容中不包含本字段

SatisfactionDesc.description_en: The description corresponding to the satisfaction key (Satisfaction) when a satisfaction survey is sent, such as "Satisfied" or "Very Satisfied". A value of "Not Sent" indicates that the satisfaction survey invitation was not sent to the customer. A value of "Not Rated" indicates that the invitation was sent but the customer did not respond
SatisfactionDesc.description_zh: 在发送满意度客户评价的情况下，该字段为满意度按键（Satisfaction）对应的描述，比如满意、非常满意。若为“未发送”，表示未发送满意度评价邀请给客户；若为“未评价”，表示发送满意度邀请给客户，但客户未评价

SkillGroupIdList.description_en: The skill group IDs of the agents involved in the call. Multiple skill group IDs are separated by commas
SkillGroupIdList.description_zh: 参与通话的座席所述的技能组ID，多个技能组ID以逗号分隔

SkillGroupNames.description_en: The skill groups of the agents involved in the call. Multiple skill groups are separated by commas
SkillGroupNames.description_zh: 参与通话的座席所述的技能组，多个技能组以逗号分隔

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the call. For inbound calls, this is when the call enters the IVR. For outbound calls, this is when the call is connected
StartTime.description_zh: 电话开始时间，内呼从进入IVR开始，外呼从开始接通计算

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
